en.name: Clotted cream
en.summary: Clotted cream is cream held at a low heat for hours until a thick golden crust forms on top. Unopened, it keeps to the use-by date on the pot; once opened, give it 3–4 days in the fridge. It freezes better than pouring cream, for about 3–4 months.
en.pantry: Clotted cream is a fresh dairy product and cannot live in a cupboard, despite being cooked. The long scald is a heat treatment, but the pots are filled and sealed cold afterwards, so the printed date is the date. On a table with scones, follow the 2-hour rule — 1 hour if the room is above 32 °C (90 °F) — and put the pot back in the fridge between servings rather than leaving it out through a long afternoon tea.
en.fridge: Keep it at 0–5 °C, sealed, and go by the use-by date on an unopened pot: that date is a limit rather than a suggestion, and no general figure would improve on it. Once opened, use it within 3–4 days — the published figure for opened cream, applied here because clotted cream is a cream whatever the spoon says. Keep the golden crust intact and scoop from one side; the crust is a physical barrier, and breaking it up across the whole surface exposes far more of the soft cream underneath.
en.freezer: Clotted cream freezes surprisingly well because there is so little water in it — at roughly 55 to 64 % fat, there is not much left to form ice crystals. Treat 3–4 months at −18 °C (0 °F) as a working limit; that figure is borrowed from what is published for heavy cream rather than measured on clotted cream. Freeze it in the unopened pot or in small tubs with a little headspace, and note that you can freeze it right up to the use-by date, not before.
en.thawing: Thaw it slowly in the fridge overnight, never on the counter, and stir the crust back in before serving. Use it within a few days and do not refreeze.
spoilage: Mould anywhere on the surface or under the lid, even a single spot.
A sour, cheesy or yeasty smell instead of a sweet cooked-cream one.
Watery separation with a grey or yellow cast to the crust.
A sharp, bitter or metallic taste — the fat has gone rancid.
tips: Buy the small pot unless you have a crowd; it does not keep long once opened.
Scoop from one side and leave the rest of the crust whole.
Use a clean dry spoon every time — jam in the pot is a classic way to ruin it.
If you want to freeze it, do it while the pot is still sealed.

faq.q: How long does clotted cream last once opened?
faq.a: About 3–4 days at 0–5 °C, which is the figure published for opened cream generally. Unopened, go by the use-by date on the pot.
Yes. Treat about 3–4 months at −18 °C as a working limit, borrowed from heavy cream. Thaw it in the fridge and stir the crust back in.

faq.q: Does clotted cream need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: Yes. The long scald is a heat treatment, but the pot is filled cold and it is still a fresh dairy product.

faq.q: Is the separated liquid under the crust normal?
faq.a: A little is. A watery pool with a grey or yellow crust and a sour smell is not, and means the pot goes.

zh.name: 凝脂奶油
zh.summary: 凝脂奶油是把鮮奶油以低溫長時間加熱，直到表面結出一層金黃硬殼的英式奶油。未開封時以罐上的有效日期為準；開封後冷藏請在 3～4 天內用完。它比液態鮮奶油更適合冷凍，大約 3～4 個月。
zh.pantry: 凝脂奶油雖然是「煮過」的，卻仍是生鮮乳製品，不能放櫥櫃。長時間加熱確實是一道熱處理，但裝罐封口是在冷卻之後才做的，所以標示日期就是標示日期。配司康擺上桌時請守 2 小時原則（室溫超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時），兩輪之間就把罐子冰回去，不要整個下午茶都放在桌上。
zh.fridge: 密封放在 0～5 °C。未開封時以罐上的有效日期為準：那是界線而不是參考值，任何通用數字都不會比它更好。開封後請在 3～4 天內用完——這是「已開封鮮奶油」的公告值，套用在這裡是因為不管質地多厚，它終究是鮮奶油。表面那層金黃硬殼盡量保持完整，固定從同一邊挖；硬殼是實質的物理屏障，把它整片挖破，等於讓底下柔軟的奶油大面積暴露。
zh.freezer: 凝脂奶油的冷凍表現出乎意料地好，因為它含水量極低——脂肪含量大約在 55 到 64 % 之間，剩下能結冰的水並不多。在 −18 °C 下把 3～4 個月當作工作上限；這個數字是借用「高脂鮮奶油」的公告值，不是針對凝脂奶油量測的。連未開封的罐子一起冷凍，或分裝小盒並留一點膨脹空間；另外要知道，冷凍可以一路做到有效日期當天，但不能超過。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏慢慢隔夜解凍，不要放室溫；上桌前把硬殼拌回去。解凍後幾天內用完，不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 表面或蓋子內側出現霉點，哪怕只有一點。
聞起來發酸、有起司味或酵母味，而不是煮過奶油的甜香。
出水分離，且硬殼泛灰或泛黃。
吃起來刺、苦或有金屬味——脂肪已經油耗了。
tips: 除非人多，否則買小罐就好；開封後放不久。
固定從同一邊挖，其餘硬殼保持完整。
每次都用乾淨乾燥的湯匙——果醬沾進罐子是最典型的失敗。
想冷凍的話，趁罐子還沒開封時就凍。

faq.q: 凝脂奶油開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 在 0～5 °C 下大約 3～4 天，這是已開封鮮奶油的公告值。未開封則以罐上有效日期為準。
可以。在 −18 °C 下把約 3～4 個月當工作上限，這個數字借自高脂鮮奶油。放冷藏解凍並把硬殼拌回去。

faq.q: 凝脂奶油一定要冷藏嗎？
faq.a: 要。長時間加熱雖是熱處理，但裝罐是冷的，它仍然是生鮮乳製品。

faq.q: 硬殼底下有分離的液體正常嗎？
faq.a: 少量是正常的。如果積出一灘水、硬殼泛灰泛黃又發酸，就不正常，整罐丟掉。
